cases.instruction_en: Turn left to enter the bedroom, passing a TV on your left and a bed on your right. Stop in front of the vanity table with a mirror on your left.

Walk straight down the hallway, passing an open living area with a couch and a lamp on your right. Continue forward, then turn right to enter a bedroom with a TV on a cabinet on your right. Walk further into the room, towards the window with pink and blue curtains, and stop to the left of the bed.

Walk forward, keeping the wall with the TV on your left and the living room with a couch on your right. Continue straight, passing a decorative screen on your left, towards the dining room ahead. When you reach the opening, turn left into the hallway. Walk straight ahead, past the painting on your right, and enter the bedroom. Proceed forward into the bedroom, keeping the TV on your left, and stop in front of the bed, with the nightstand to its right.

From the bathroom area, turn right. Pass by the paneled wall on your right, then turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing several doorways on both your left and right sides. Enter the large room at the end of the hallway, keeping a bed or lounge area on your right, and stop next to the dining table with chairs on your left.

Turn right to enter the bedroom, then immediately turn left and walk straight down the hallway. Continue straight through the open living area, passing a dining table on your left and a bed on your right. Turn left, then walk forward past the grey door with the red line on your right. Turn left to enter the kitchen, then walk straight through the kitchen, passing counters on both sides, and stop in front of the window at the end.

Turn left towards the open doorway. Walk through the doorway, entering the hallway. Continue straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom entrance on your right. At the end of the hallway, turn left to enter the bedroom. Stop in front of the bed, with the window visible ahead.

Walk through the doorway to enter the combined living and dining area. Pass the sofa and coffee tables on your left and the dining table with kitchen cabinets on your right. Continue to walk straight across the room, keeping the TV on your left, and stop directly in front of the window.

Walk forward out of the bathroom and into the hallway. Proceed straight down the hallway, with a sink on your left and a living area with a TV on your right. Continue straight past a dark wooden panel on your right, then turn right to enter the bedroom. Walk forward alongside the bed on your right, and stop in front of the window with a wardrobe on your left.

Turn right to exit the closet and enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, then turn right to enter the living area. Continue walking forward through the living area, with a large white and black cabinet unit on your right. Stop in front of the dark door.

Walk forward, passing the refrigerator on your right and the dining table on your left, into the living room. Continue straight through the living room, keeping the television on your left. Turn right, passing a dark sofa on your left, to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, with a wardrobe on your right, and stop in front of the dark wooden door.

Walk straight past the counter on your left and the living room entrance on your right. Turn right to enter the bedroom. Continue walking forward, with the bed on your right and the wardrobes on your left. Stop in front of the window.

Go through the doorway in front of you, leaving the tiled wall and sink of the bathroom on your right. Turn right into the hallway, keeping the plain beige wall on your left. Walk straight down the hallway, passing an open room with a dark bookshelf on your left and a decorative wall with hexagonal shelves on your right. Turn left to enter the bedroom. Walk straight through the bedroom, with the bed on your right and a desk with shelves on your left, and stop in front of the desk, facing the window.

Walk straight forward through the doorway, passing a long bench on your left and built-in cabinets with a handbag on your right. Enter the living room, keeping the main seating area with the sofa and coffee table on your right. Turn right to face the long hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, with built-in cabinetry featuring a wine rack on your left, and then continue past a doorway on your left and another doorway on your right. Enter the bedroom at the end of the hallway, and stop in front of the bed.

From your position in the bedroom, walk forward past the dresser on your left and the bed and wardrobe on your right. Go through the doorway in front of you to enter the hallway. In the hallway, turn right to enter the bathroom with the checkerboard floor. Walk straight towards the window, keeping the sink on your left, and stop in front of the window.

Walk forward past the dining table on your right and into the open room with the living room on your left. Turn right to enter a hallway, with the living room now on your right. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a painting on your left. Turn right through the open doorway to enter the bedroom. Walk forward, passing the bed on your left, and stop in front of the window.

Turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a room with a towel rack on your right. Turn left to enter the living room, passing the television on your left. Continue walking forward, then turn right to enter the dining area. Walk past the dining table on your left, and stop in front of the dark wooden cabinet under the window.

Walk past the wooden table on your left and go through the doorway into the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a painting on your left and a bedroom opening on your left. Continue straight to enter the living room, passing a couch and TV on your left. Turn right towards the dining table. Walk past the dining table on your left, then enter the kitchen, stopping in front of the kitchen counters with a window to your left.

Enter the hallway. Continue straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom entrance on your left. Enter the living room, keeping a couch and a TV on your left. Turn left and go through the doorway into the bedroom. Walk straight into the bedroom, keeping a wardrobe on your right and the bed on your right. Stop in front of the window with curtains.

Walk straight down the hallway. Pass a round mirror on your left and then turn right to enter the living room area. Walk forward with an illuminated panel on your right and a sofa on your left. Turn left into the open doorway beside the TV. Continue straight, passing an open bathroom on your right. Stop in front of the TV, with the bed on your right and a window in front of you.

Turn left to enter the hallway from the room with the wardrobe. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your right and an open doorway to a bedroom on your left. Go through the open archway at the end of the hallway to enter the living room. Walk forward, passing a sofa and TV on your left, towards the open doorway on your left. Enter the sunroom through this doorway, and turn left. Stop in front of the sofa in the living room, with the large windows on your right.

Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your right and a framed picture on your left, as the floor transitions from wood to dark grey tiles. Continue straight past a bedroom entrance on your left. At the end of the hallway, turn right to enter the living room area, with a sofa and TV on your left and dining chairs on your right. Walk forward, passing a white door on your right. Stop in front of the coffee table and sofa, facing the large window.

Turn left to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a console table with a TV on your right. Then, turn left into the living room area, passing a sofa on your right. Proceed towards the dining table with chairs, and stop in front of the dining table.

Walk forward into the hallway. Proceed straight, passing a bathroom on your left. Continue straight, passing a brown pillar on your right as you enter an open living area. Turn right, keeping the main living room area with a sofa and TV on your left. Walk straight, passing a dining table with chairs on your right. Stop in front of the wall displaying two framed pictures, to the right of the white door.

Turn right from your current position, walking past a decorative stand and a TV on your left. Continue straight and enter the doorway on your right, keeping the built-in wardrobes on your left. Walk forward into the open hallway with a light-colored rug, passing wall art on your right. Continue straight through this hallway, passing a kitchen and dining area on your left. Turn right to enter the next room, passing a large potted plant on your left as you go through the doorway. Walk straight into the living room, passing the TV console on your right, and stop in front of the couch with blue and yellow pillows.

Turn right into the hallway, with a green framed artwork on your left and a wall displaying four framed artworks on your right. Walk straight through this hallway, passing a tall potted plant on your left and an open kitchen on your right. Go through the doorway straight ahead to enter the bedroom. Walk towards the bed on your left, and stop next to the bedside table on the right side of the bed.

Go through the doorway and enter the room, keeping the wall with four framed artworks on your right. Walk forward, passing a tall potted plant on your right, then turn right into the dining area. Proceed forward, keeping the dining table on your left and a large window with bamboo blinds on your right, and stop in front of the window.

Turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a doorway to a bathroom on your left and a doorway to a room with white folding doors straight ahead. Continue straight, passing a doorway to a library on your left and a doorway to a bedroom on your right. Proceed into the open living area, with a living room on your left and a dining table on your right. Walk further into the living room, keeping the TV wall on your right and the sofas and coffee table on your left. Stop in front of the large window, with the main sofa to your left.

Turn left from your current position to face a hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom doorway on your left. Go through the doorway at the end of the hallway to enter a large open room. Walk straight through this room, keeping the dining table on your right, and continue past a living room area also on your right. Enter the hallway ahead of you. Walk straight down this hallway, passing an open doorway on your left. At the end of the hallway, turn right, then walk straight past the bathroom on your left. Enter the bedroom ahead, and stop in front of the bed.

Walk forward in the hallway, passing a couch and a framed picture on your right. Continue straight, passing a long windowed section on your left and a doorway on your right containing a washing machine. Proceed further, passing an open doorway on your left that reveals a bedroom, and stop when you reach the end of the hallway with a wall in front of you and open doorways to your left and right. Turn right into the doorway. Enter the room with the bunk beds on your left and a desk on your right. Walk forward into the room and stop in front of the bunk beds.

Walk forward, passing the dining table on your right and entering the living room. Continue straight through the living room, keeping the large couch and TV on your right. Turn left to enter a hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a decorative wall hanging on your right and doorways on both your left and right. At the end of the hallway, with the bathroom in front of you, turn left to enter the bedroom. Walk into the bedroom, passing the bunk bed on your left and the large windows on your right, then stop near the wall on your right that has multiple framed pictures.

Walk straight down the initial hallway, keeping a white wardrobe on your right, and go through the open doorway in front of you. Then, turn left to enter the next room. Walk forward into this room, passing a gray armchair with a red blanket on your right, and stop in front of the three framed pictures on the wall to your left.

Walk forward, passing the dining area on your right. Turn left, with the painting on the wall to your left, to face two doorways. Go through the right doorway to enter the bedroom. Walk straight into the bedroom, passing the TV mounted on the wall to your right. Stop to the left of the bed, in front of the nightstand and the open wardrobe on your left.

Turn right to face the bathroom doorway. Enter the bathroom doorway, with the sink on your left and the toilet on your right. Immediately turn left into the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, proceeding past the white cabinets on your right. Enter the living and dining area, and stop in front of the dining table, with the sofa on your left and the dining bench on your right.

From the position facing the bathroom entrance on your left and the bedroom entrance on your right, turn right into the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing white cupboards on your right. Enter the living and dining area, walking past the dining table on your right. Stop in front of the coffee table, with the sofa on your left.
